title: SENIOR FINANCIAL REPORTING ANALYST (Mandeville/Manchester)
description: SENIOR FINANCIAL REPORTING ANALYST (Mandeville/Manchester) Isratech Jamaica Manchester Not disclosed Permanent full-time Updated 05/11/2026 HRM Apply Now Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save We are seeking a detail-oriented Senior Financial Reporting Analyst to join our Accounting/Finance team and support financial reporting and analysis across all divisions. SENIOR FINANCIAL REPORTING ANALYST Department: Accounting / Finance Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent Reporting to the CFO, the Senior Financial Reporting Analyst will establish and maintain processes to ensure timely, reliable financial reporting across the Company's operations, obligations, investments and commitments. The role supports all divisions and works closely with the CEO, CFO, and Projects Director on revenue, profitability, and project performance analysis. Key Responsibilities: Prepare weekly, monthly and quarterly revenue reports for all divisions and locations for the CEO/CFO Prepare post-evaluation of major revenue projects, including margin analysis Assist in the pricing review process to protect business margins Prepare quarterly management financial reports and monthly direct cash flow reports Reconcile intercompany balances with the receivables and payables team Prepare assigned audit schedules annually and assist with the annual audited financial statements Support the CFO in preparing the annual budget Prepare quarterly performance reports for sales team incentive payments Assist in implementing business improvement processes as needed Model the viability of distribution arrangements and capital expansion projects Assist department heads in developing KPI models for business optimization Perform cost-saving and business performance analysis as needed Ensure accurate recording of all transactions in line with company standards and accounting systems Other duties as assigned by the CFO Qualifications & Experience: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Systems, Administration, or a related field Pursuing ACCA or an equivalent professional accounting qualification Minimum 3 years' experience in an accounting role Minimum 2 years' experience as a Finance or Business Analyst Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Working knowledge of QuickBooks and comfort using AI tools in daily work Core Competencies: Strong accounting and financial reporting skills, with sound interpretation and analytical ability Budget management and ability to model business scenarios Knowledge of accounting administration and accounting software Excellent communication skills and ability to work well as part of a team Thanks for your interest in and application for this role. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Ref: SENIOR FINANCIAL REPORTING ANALYSTCCC Apply Now
